The site of Gyrton is disputed. The stored point is the Barrington Atlas/DARE location at Mourlari near Evangelismos (DARE: 39.798151, 22.569853, precision 2000 m; the English Wikipedia coordinates are a copy of DARE, so there is no second independent source for it). Other sources put Gyrtone at the Bakraina acropolis by modern Gyrtoni, 11-12 km to the south-west (Mycenaean Atlas C1351 after Hope Simpson: 39.76126, 22.446632; Wikidata 39.759, 22.443; ToposText, low confidence, 39.7573, 22.4031), and the Tempi municipality states that the exact location of the ancient city has not yet been identified. With no agreed site, the point is held for the owner.
